interfaces.name: ExerciseKind
interfaces.signature: enum ExerciseKind: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable { case squat, pushUp, plank }
interfaces.notes: Discriminator on WorkoutSession; drives which rule engine/metric fields are populated.

interfaces.name: SessionStatus
interfaces.signature: enum SessionStatus: String, Codable, Sendable { case inProgress, finalizing, completed, completedEndedEarly }
interfaces.notes: finalizing added explicitly so a crash between End-tap and write-complete is reconciled identically to inProgress, not mistaken for a clean completion.

interfaces.name: HealthKitWriteStatus
interfaces.signature: enum HealthKitWriteStatus: String, Codable, Sendable { case notAttempted, written, deniedPermission, failed, entitlementUnavailable }
interfaces.notes: entitlementUnavailable covers the presumed-blocked-without-paid-account case from ios_architecture_review.

interfaces.name: FormFlagRecord
interfaces.signature: struct FormFlagRecord: Codable, Hashable, Sendable { let ruleID: String; let jointsInvolved: [String]; let measuredDegrees: Double; let thresholdDegrees: Double; let message: String; let occurredAtElapsed: TimeInterval }
interfaces.notes: message must always name the specific measured/threshold values per DEC-next_steps_small-003, never generic text.

interfaces.name: WorkoutSession
interfaces.signature: @Model final class WorkoutSession { var id: UUID; var exercise: ExerciseKind; var startedAt: Date; var elapsedTime: TimeInterval; var repCount: Int?; var holdDuration: TimeInterval?; var outOfFormSeconds: TimeInterval?; var formFlags: [FormFlagRecord]; var clipRelativePath: String?; var isDemo: Bool; var sessionStatus: SessionStatus; var lastPersistedRepCount: Int; var lastPersistedElapsedTime: TimeInterval; var classifierWasOverridden: Bool; var healthKitWriteStatus: HealthKitWriteStatus }
interfaces.notes: Flat model, no inheritance, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-006. repCount populated for squat/pushUp; holdDuration+outOfFormSeconds for plank.

interfaces.name: Joint
interfaces.signature: enum Joint: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable { case nose, leftShoulder, rightShoulder, leftElbow, rightElbow, leftWrist, rightWrist, leftHip, rightHip, leftKnee, rightKnee, leftAnkle, rightAnkle }
interfaces.notes: Subset of VNHumanBodyPoseObservation.JointName actually consumed by rule engines.

interfaces.name: JointFrame
interfaces.signature: struct JointFrame: Sendable { let timestamp: TimeInterval; let points: [Joint: JointPoint] } ; struct JointPoint: Sendable { let location: CGPoint; let confidence: Float }
interfaces.notes: The single decoupling type — rule engines, classifier, and demo fixtures all consume this, never VNHumanBodyPoseObservation directly.

interfaces.name: PoseObservationAdapter
interfaces.signature: enum PoseObservationAdapter { static func selectPrimaryObservation(_ observations: [VNHumanBodyPoseObservation]) -> VNHumanBodyPoseObservation?; static func makeJointFrame(from observation: VNHumanBodyPoseObservation, timestamp: TimeInterval) -> JointFrame }
interfaces.notes: selectPrimaryObservation picks largest bounding-box area, tie-broken by average joint confidence, to handle multi-person-in-frame.

interfaces.name: ExerciseRuleEngine
interfaces.signature: protocol ExerciseRuleEngine { var exercise: ExerciseKind { get }; mutating func ingest(_ frame: JointFrame) -> [RuleEngineEvent]; mutating func reset() }
interfaces.notes: Returns an array since a single frame can both count a rep and emit a flag.

interfaces.name: RuleEngineEvent
interfaces.signature: enum RuleEngineEvent: Sendable { case repCounted(totalReps: Int); case formFlag(FormFlagRecord); case holdProgress(isOutOfForm: Bool, cumulativeOutOfFormSeconds: TimeInterval) }

interfaces.name: SquatRuleEngine
interfaces.signature: struct SquatRuleEngine: ExerciseRuleEngine { init(standingThresholdDegrees: Double = 160, depthThresholdDegrees: Double = 100, minDwellFrames: Int = 3) }
interfaces.notes: Knee angle (hip-knee-ankle), averaged both legs with confidence-weighted single-leg fallback; flags 'Squat depth: hips only reached ~Xdeg knee bend (target: below 100deg)' when a rep's minimum stays above 100.

interfaces.name: PushUpRuleEngine
interfaces.signature: struct PushUpRuleEngine: ExerciseRuleEngine { init(standingThresholdDegrees: Double = 160, depthThresholdDegrees: Double = 90, minDwellFrames: Int = 3) }
interfaces.notes: Elbow angle (shoulder-elbow-wrist); same flag pattern as squat naming measured degrees.

interfaces.name: PlankRuleEngine
interfaces.signature: struct PlankRuleEngine: ExerciseRuleEngine { init(targetHipAngleDegrees: Double = 180, toleranceDegrees: Double = 15, sustainedSeconds: TimeInterval = 1.0) }
interfaces.notes: Hip angle (shoulder-hip-ankle); accrues outOfFormSeconds once out-of-tolerance for sustainedSeconds, flag names sagging vs. piking direction.

interfaces.name: RepStateMachine
interfaces.signature: struct RepStateMachine { init(enterThreshold: Double, exitThreshold: Double, minDwellFrames: Int); mutating func update(measurement: Double) -> RepStateTransition? } ; enum RepStateTransition { case enteredBottom, exitedBottom(reachedDepth: Bool) }
interfaces.notes: Shared hysteresis/debounce primitive used by all three rule engines per DEC-product_research-005.

interfaces.name: ExerciseClassifier
interfaces.signature: protocol ExerciseClassifier { var methodDescription: String { get }; mutating func classify(_ frame: JointFrame) -> ExerciseKind? }
interfaces.notes: methodDescription is the exact user-facing disclosure string, must render in onboarding + Settings.

interfaces.name: HeuristicExerciseClassifier
interfaces.signature: struct HeuristicExerciseClassifier: ExerciseClassifier { init(rollingWindowSeconds: TimeInterval = 2.0) }
interfaces.notes: No bundled Core ML model — torso-orientation + joint-cyclicity-variance heuristic, documented in-app per DEC-prompt_contract-003.

interfaces.name: CaptureSessionModel
interfaces.signature: @MainActor @Observable final class CaptureSessionModel { private(set) var phase: CapturePhase; func startCapture(exercise: ExerciseKind?, isDemo: Bool) async; func overrideClassifiedExercise(_ exercise: ExerciseKind); func endSet() async }
interfaces.notes: Sole writer to SwiftData and sole publisher to WatchRelay per DEC-design_handoff-001. Sets sessionStatus to .finalizing synchronously the instant endSet() is called, before the write completes.

interfaces.name: CapturePhase
interfaces.signature: enum CapturePhase: Sendable { case checkingCapability; case blocked(CameraCapabilityStatus); case readyToRecord(aligned: Bool); case inSession(repCount: Int, elapsed: TimeInterval, exercise: ExerciseKind); case finalizing }

interfaces.name: CameraCapabilityStatus
interfaces.signature: enum CameraCapabilityStatus: Sendable { case ready, noHardware, denied, restricted }
interfaces.notes: Three distinct honest sub-states per DEC-detailed_discussion-004.

interfaces.name: CameraCapabilityDetecting
interfaces.signature: protocol CameraCapabilityDetecting { func currentStatus() -> CameraCapabilityStatus }
interfaces.notes: Both Home and the capture modal call this independently per DEC-design_handoff-009.

interfaces.name: VisionPoseProcessor
interfaces.signature: final class VisionPoseProcessor: NSObject, AVCaptureVideoDataOutputSampleBufferDelegate { var onJointFrame: (@Sendable (JointFrame) -> Void)?; func captureOutput(_ output: AVCaptureOutput, didOutput sampleBuffer: CMSampleBuffer, from connection: AVCaptureConnection) }
interfaces.notes: alwaysDiscardsLateVideoFrames = true on the output; runs off-main, hops to MainActor only via onJointFrame delivery.

interfaces.name: WatchRelay
interfaces.signature: protocol WatchRelay { var isReachable: Bool { get }; var isPairedAndInstalled: Bool { get }; func sendRepUpdate(_ update: WatchRepUpdate) throws; func pushLastKnownState(_ snapshot: WatchSessionSnapshot) }
interfaces.notes: Concrete WCSession-backed conformance lives in services_utilities; a FakeWatchRelay for tests lives alongside the test target.

interfaces.name: WatchRepUpdate
interfaces.signature: struct WatchRepUpdate: Codable, Sendable { let repCount: Int; let elapsedTime: TimeInterval; let exercise: ExerciseKind }

interfaces.name: WatchSessionSnapshot
interfaces.signature: struct WatchSessionSnapshot: Codable, Sendable { let hasActiveSession: Bool; let repCount: Int?; let elapsedTime: TimeInterval?; let exercise: ExerciseKind? }
interfaces.notes: Delivered via updateApplicationContext so a Watch opened after the fact shows last-known state.

interfaces.name: SessionRepository
interfaces.signature: @ModelActor actor SessionRepository { func startSession(exercise: ExerciseKind, isDemo: Bool) -> PersistentIdentifier; func persistIncrementalProgress(id: PersistentIdentifier, repCount: Int?, elapsedTime: TimeInterval, holdDuration: TimeInterval?, outOfFormSeconds: TimeInterval?); func appendFormFlag(id: PersistentIdentifier, flag: FormFlagRecord); func markFinalizing(id: PersistentIdentifier); func finalize(id: PersistentIdentifier, endedEarly: Bool); func fetchSessions(includeDemo: Bool, exercise: ExerciseKind?) -> [WorkoutSession] }
interfaces.notes: All active-session writes go through this background actor, never the main ModelContext, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-007.

interfaces.name: SessionReconciliationService
interfaces.signature: struct SessionReconciliationService { func reconcileOrphanedSessions(in repository: SessionRepository) async -> Int }
interfaces.notes: Runs at launch; treats both .inProgress and .finalizing orphans as .completedEndedEarly.

interfaces.name: isDemoQueryFilter
interfaces.signature: enum SessionQuerying { static func predicate(includeDemo: Bool, exercise: ExerciseKind?) -> Predicate<WorkoutSession> }
interfaces.notes: Single reusable predicate used identically by Charts, HealthKit write eligibility, and export, per DEC-detailed_discussion-006.

interfaces.name: CapabilityGap
interfaces.signature: struct CapabilityGap: Identifiable, Codable, Sendable { let id: UUID; let category: GapCategory; let title: String; let detail: String; let detectedAt: Date } ; enum GapCategory: String, Codable, Sendable { case camera, watch, healthKit, catalystSync, storeKit }

interfaces.name: KnownLimitsStore
interfaces.signature: @MainActor @Observable final class KnownLimitsStore { private(set) var gaps: [CapabilityGap]; func record(_ gap: CapabilityGap) }
interfaces.notes: Pre-seeded at launch with the HealthKit-entitlement-presumed-blocked gap per DEC-ios_architecture_review-010.

interfaces.name: HealthKitWriting
interfaces.signature: protocol HealthKitWriting { func requestAuthorization() async -> HealthKitAuthStatus; func writeWorkout(session: WorkoutSession) async -> HealthKitWriteStatus } ; enum HealthKitAuthStatus: Sendable { case notDetermined, authorized, denied, unavailableEntitlement }
interfaces.notes: Write-only scope, type+duration only, no energy estimate, per DEC-detailed_discussion-005.

interfaces.name: DemoFixtureProvider
interfaces.signature: enum DemoFixtureProvider { static func loadFixture() -> DemoFixture } ; struct DemoFixture: Sendable { let frames: [JointFrame]; let exercise: ExerciseKind; let videoResourceName: String }
interfaces.notes: Same canned JointFrame sequence backs both this and the rule-engine unit tests, proving fixture and live pipeline are provably the same code path.

interfaces.name: SessionExportArchive
interfaces.signature: struct SessionExportArchive: Codable, Sendable { let schemaVersion: Int; let exportedAt: Date; let sessions: [WorkoutSessionExportDTO] }
interfaces.notes: Only path by which Catalyst's local store gets real (non-demo) data, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-001.

interfaces.name: SessionExportService
interfaces.signature: protocol SessionExportService { func exportArchive(includeDemo: Bool) throws -> URL }
interfaces.notes: iPhone-side only; user-initiated, AirDrop/Files/cable transfer, never automatic sync.

interfaces.name: SessionImportService
interfaces.signature: protocol SessionImportService { func importArchive(from url: URL) throws -> Int }
interfaces.notes: Catalyst-side only; returns count of sessions imported into Catalyst's own local SwiftData store.

interfaces.name: HomeView
interfaces.signature: struct HomeView: View
interfaces.notes: Reads CapturePhase-adjacent capability state and last-session recap; never itself writes SwiftData.

interfaces.name: CaptureRootView
interfaces.signature: struct CaptureRootView: View { let model: CaptureSessionModel }
interfaces.notes: fullScreenCover content; presents SilhouetteAlignmentGuide/RepHeroCounter/ClassifierChip/AmberRuleAnnotation/FinalizingProgressRing per CapturePhase.

interfaces.name: PostSetSummarySheet
interfaces.signature: struct PostSetSummarySheet: View { let session: WorkoutSession }
interfaces.notes: Reuses SessionDetailView content per DEC-design_discussion-006.

interfaces.name: HistoryView
interfaces.signature: struct HistoryView: View
interfaces.notes: List/calendar, demo rows dashed+badged.

interfaces.name: SessionDetailView
interfaces.signature: struct SessionDetailView: View { let session: WorkoutSession }
interfaces.notes: On Catalyst, adds CatalystClipScrubber + SkeletonOverlayToggle via #if targetEnvironment(macCatalyst).

interfaces.name: ExerciseTrendChart
interfaces.signature: struct ExerciseTrendChart: View { let exercise: ExerciseKind }
interfaces.notes: Queries via SessionQuerying.predicate(includeDemo: false, ...); shows 'demo sessions excluded' disclosure when any exist.

interfaces.name: SettingsView
interfaces.signature: struct SettingsView: View
interfaces.notes: Unfinished should-have rows route to KnownLimitsView, never a dead control, per DEC-design_discussion-007.

interfaces.name: KnownLimitsView
interfaces.signature: struct KnownLimitsView: View { let store: KnownLimitsStore }

interfaces.name: CatalystBrowserView
interfaces.signature: struct CatalystBrowserView: View
interfaces.notes: NavigationSplitView sidebar reading Catalyst's own local store; gated #if targetEnvironment(macCatalyst).

interfaces.name: WatchIdleView
interfaces.signature: struct WatchIdleView: View { let snapshot: WatchSessionSnapshot }
interfaces.notes: Shows honest 'iPhone unreachable' glance, never a spinner.

interfaces.name: WatchInSessionView
interfaces.signature: struct WatchInSessionView: View { let update: WatchRepUpdate }
interfaces.notes: Haptic per received rep update.

interfaces.name: Theme
interfaces.signature: enum Theme { enum Colors {}; enum Typography {}; enum Spacing {}; enum Radii {} }
interfaces.notes: Literal source for every token from design_handoff (amberStroke/amberText split, RepHero Dynamic Type rule, 8pt grid).

interfaces.name: AccessibilityAnnouncer
interfaces.signature: enum AccessibilityAnnouncer { static func announceRep(_ count: Int); static func announceFlag(_ flag: FormFlagRecord) }
interfaces.notes: Posts AccessibilityNotification.Announcement explicitly per DEC-design_handoff-007, not label diffing.

interfaces.name: InterruptionCoordinator
interfaces.signature: final class InterruptionCoordinator { func observeCaptureSession(_ session: AVCaptureSession, model: CaptureSessionModel) }
interfaces.notes: Routes AVCaptureSession.wasInterruptedNotification into the same endSet()-as-endedEarly path used for backgrounding/crash, per DEC-ios_architecture_review-004.
